lines.say: This is Vigil, warning a borrower that their MUSD loan just slipped below their alert line.
lines.caption: Vigil, warning a borrower: their MUSD loan just slipped below its alert line.

lines.say: On Mezo, there are two ways to lose your Bitcoin.
lines.caption: On Mezo, there are two ways to lose your Bitcoin.

lines.say: Liquidation, below one hundred and ten percent.
lines.caption: Liquidation, below 110%.

lines.say: And redemption. Mezo takes Bitcoin from the lowest-ratio loans first, even healthy ones. Most borrowers never see it coming.
lines.caption: And redemption: Mezo takes BTC from the lowest-ratio loans first, even healthy ones. Most borrowers never see it coming.

lines.say: Vigil watches both. Send it your Mezo address.
lines.caption: Vigil watches both. Send it your Mezo address.

lines.say: Every minute, it reads every loan on Mezo, and tells you your liquidation price, your place in the redemption queue, and how long interest alone takes to hurt you.
lines.caption: Every minute it reads every loan on Mezo: your liquidation price, your place in the redemption queue, and how long interest alone takes to hurt you.

lines.say: The same view lives on the web. This is a real loan on Mezo testnet, read live.
lines.caption: The same view on the web: a real loan on Mezo testnet, read live.

lines.say: For the bad night, set up a rescue. Keep a MUSD reserve, pick a trigger, and sign Mezo's own repay message, once.
lines.caption: For the bad night, set up a rescue: keep a MUSD reserve, pick a trigger, and sign Mezo's own repay message once.

lines.say: Mezo checks that signature itself, so Vigil can't change the amount, the loan, or the deadline.
lines.caption: Mezo checks that signature itself, so Vigil can't change the amount, the loan or the deadline.

lines.say: Here it is on chain. When this test loan crossed its trigger, Vigil's keeper submitted the rescue on its own.
lines.caption: On-chain: when this test loan crossed its trigger, Vigil's keeper submitted the rescue on its own.

lines.say: Three hundred MUSD repaid from the reserve, and the ratio went from about one thirty-one, to one forty-nine percent.
lines.caption: 300 MUSD repaid from the reserve. Ratio 130.9% → 148.8%.

lines.say: It also refuses what it should. A rescue while the loan is above its trigger. And a signature with a changed amount, which Mezo rejects itself.
lines.caption: It refuses what it should: a rescue above the trigger, and a signature with a changed amount, which Mezo rejects itself.

lines.say: The contract has no owner, its source is verified, and twelve fork tests run against Mezo's real contracts.
lines.caption: No owner. Verified source. 12 fork tests against Mezo's real contracts.

lines.say: Vigil. A guard for MUSD loans on Mezo. Try it on Telegram today.
lines.caption: Vigil: a guard for MUSD loans on Mezo. Try it on Telegram today.
